photos.file: Brandt's cormorants and California sea lions on a rock, La Jolla Cove, San Diego, California.jpg
photos.desc: Brandt's cormorants (Urile penicillatus) and California sea lions (Zalophus californianus) on an offshore rock, in front of the beach and the sandstone sea caves.

photos.file: California sea lion with a raised fore-flipper on a mooring buoy, San Diego Bay, California.jpg
photos.desc: California sea lion (Zalophus californianus) lying on a yellow mooring buoy with one fore-flipper raised; the head of a second sea lion breaks the surface at the foot of the buoy.
